subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable storage shape should replace inline per-session `systemPromptReport` while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and context-reporting semantics?
rationale: The remaining bug is source-supported and field-supported, but the current report metadata is intentionally load-bearing for warning dedupe and diagnostics, so automation should not choose the long-term data contract unilaterally.

options.title: Persist Minimal Report State
options.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe and current display fields in session rows, making bulky tools/skills/workspace report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

options.title: Use Out-Of-Line Report Blobs
options.body: Move large repeated report sections to content-addressed storage and keep compact refs in `sessions.json`, similar to the skill-prompt mitigation.

options.title: Keep Inline Reports
options.body: Retain the current inline report design and rely on retention/capping, accepting continued duplicated metadata in retained session rows.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Report State
recommendation.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe and current display fields in session rows, making bulky tools/skills/workspace report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest history across the prompt-report-adjacent session-store path and the recent persisted skill-prompt mitigation.
